title: Asynchronous Verified Semantic Caching for Tiered LLM Architectures
authors: Asmit Kumar Singh; Haozhe Wang; Laxmi Naga Santosh Attaluri; Tak Chiam; Weihua Zhu

problem_statement.en: Production tiered LLM caches use a single static similarity threshold that forces a trade-off between conservative thresholds that miss reuse opportunities and aggressive thresholds that risk serving incorrect responses.
problem_statement.zh: 生產環境的階層式 LLM 快取依賴單一靜態相似度閾值，在保守閾值（錯失重用機會）與激進閾值（可能回傳不正確回應）之間強制取捨。

key_innovation.en: Krites, an asynchronous, LLM-judged caching policy that verifies static cache misses in the similarity grey zone off-path and promotes approved matches into the dynamic cache via an auxiliary overwrite.
key_innovation.zh: Krites 是一種非同步、由 LLM 判斷的快取策略：對靜態快取未命中但落在相似度灰色地帶的查詢進行離線驗證，並將通過審核的匹配項目透過輔助覆寫提升至動態快取。

key_improvements.en: Up to 3.9x increase in static-origin served fraction (136% for conversational, 290% for search) with unchanged critical path latency.
key_improvements.zh: 靜態快取命中比例最高提升 3.9x（對話場景提升 136%，搜尋場景提升 290%），且關鍵路徑延遲維持不變。
